verdict.rationale: Portkey's docs pitch a drop-in path for existing OpenAI Python/Node SDK code: change the base URL to https://api.portkey.ai/v1 and use one Portkey API key to reach multiple providers. The documented flow also adds Portkey-specific headers, and model names use `@provider-slug/model-name`, so the change is not strictly limited to the base URL and key. Missing for 10: evidence that the base URL and key alone suffice without extra headers or model-string changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
